skill.name: workflow-patterns
skill.description: Guides agents through Conductor TDD tasks with phase checkpoints, verification gates, commits, and progress tracking.
skill.summary: Structured TDD workflow guidance for task implementation, verification, checkpoints, and git tracking.

content.value_statement: Task plans can drift when implementation, tests, commits, and approvals are handled inconsistently. This skill provides a structured TDD workflow with checkpoints, verification gates, and git tracking.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of the next pending task from plan.md.
Defines RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR steps for task work.
Explains phase checkpoint approval before continuing work.
Provides commit message and git note patterns for traceability.
Lists quality gates for tests, coverage, linting, types, and security.
Shows how to document deviations, blockers, and checkpoint results.
limitations: It assumes the project uses Conductor plan and track files.
It does not choose project-specific test, lint, or type commands.
It does not replace human approval at phase checkpoints.
It does not implement domain features without project requirements.

use_cases.title: Implement Planned Tasks
use_cases.description: Follow a plan file through one task at a time with tests, commits, and progress updates.

use_cases.title: Review Phase Readiness
use_cases.description: Check that tests, coverage, documentation, and manual verification are complete before a checkpoint.

use_cases.title: Coordinate AI Coding Agents
use_cases.description: Give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code a repeatable workflow for task execution and status tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Start Next Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-patterns to find the next pending task in plan.md. Mark it in progress and explain the first test to write.

prompt_templates.title: Run TDD Cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-patterns for this task. Write failing tests first, implement the smallest change, then refactor after tests pass.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Phase Checkpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-patterns to prepare a phase checkpoint. List automated results, manual verification items, and approval requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Deviation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use workflow-patterns to document this implementation deviation. Update the plan notes, affected requirements, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Start the next task in the current phase.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the next unchecked task, marks it in progress, and proposes the first failing test.
The assistant summarizes changed files, records verification status, and prepares task completion notes with a commit reference.

output_examples.input: Finish phase one and request approval.
output_examples.output: The assistant presents automated verification results, manual checks, and a clear request for human approval before continuing.

best_practices: Write the failing test before implementation work starts.
Keep commits focused on one logical task or checkpoint.
Record deviations and approval decisions in the plan files.
anti_patterns: Do not skip the RED step to save time.
Do not continue past a checkpoint without explicit approval.
Do not mark a task complete while tests or quality gates fail.

faq.question: What workflow does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Conductor-style task implementation with TDD, phase checkpoints, git commits, and verification gates.

faq.question: Can it be used outside Conductor projects?
faq.answer: Yes, but the project should have a clear task plan and comparable checkpoint files.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It tells the agent when tests should run and what results to verify.

faq.question: Does it require git?
faq.answer: The workflow expects git for commits, notes, SHAs, and checkpoints.

faq.question: How does it handle blocked tasks?
faq.answer: It tells the agent to mark blockers, document the reason, and look for safe parallel work.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is described as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
